Name: More custom gems and minerals
Author: isari112
Description:
This mod adds exactly what the name of it suggests. It adds 37 new items (and 38 ores), including primarily gems from real life (however, there are four special crystals I plan to use for my other mod.) I haven't seen these items in any other mod, so it should be compatible with all mods, but let me know if there is some sort of problem with compatibility. :)

The main photo is edited so it shows more nodes! In the game itself, they are pretty rare!

I've made all assets by hand, HOWEVER, I've based the spritework on already-existing mods (mainly [url=http://https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10227723]more gem mod[/url] by Kaya), so it would fit it. Most of these were, however, just rotated/recoloured vanilla sprites, so I've decided to just do the same. It includes some animations too. (However, only for special crystals) Have fun with the mod and let me know if there are any problems! :)
